title: Functorial cokernel-section comparison for principal thickenings
statement: For any commutative ring R, element g and open W in Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], put p_n = multiplication by the restricted g^(n+1) on O_W and i_n = image inclusion of p_n. There are additive equivalences e_n from H^0(W,cokernel(i_n)) to global sections of the nth quotient-power thickening of W. They carry H^0 of the quotient projection, under the canonical identification H^0(O_W)=Gamma(W,O_W), to restriction of ambient functions. For every kappa:image(p_m)->image(p_n) commuting with inclusions and every h:W_n->W_m over W, e_n composed with H^0 of the induced cokernel map equals h.appTop composed with e_m. There is no H^1 assertion or lifting assertion.

source.place: Tags 01IH (affine closed subschemes), 01QP (ideal inclusion and factorization), 01DZ (degree-zero cohomology)

proof.text: For each n, Ideal.mk_ker and Ideal.span_singleton_pow identify the adic defining ideal with the principal ideal generated by g^(n+1). Apply principal_quotient_multiplication_image to W.ι, the structure module, and g^(n+1); map_pow identifies the scalar. This gives an isomorphism of multiplication and ideal-action images preserving their inclusions. The quotient immersion is closed by surjectivity, and its base change to W is closed.

Apply closedImmersion_unit_quotient to j_n:W_n->W and O_W. Compare its chosen tensor adjunction with the canonical tensor adjunction using Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. Compose with tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso: the resulting isomorphism from the ideal-action cokernel to j_n*O_Wn takes the quotient projection to the canonical structure-sheaf map. Transport the image inclusion using cokernel.mapIso to obtain E_n from the multiplication-image cokernel with the same projection equation.

Define e_n by composing Modules.H.zeroLinearEquiv with the section equivalence Modules.appLinearEquivOfIso of E_n. Modules.H.zeroLinearEquiv is natural by Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality. Evaluate the projection equation on top sections and cancel the H^0-to-sections inverse to get the first required equation. Global sections of the pushforward structure module are definitionally the functions on W_n.

For h:W_n->W_m over W, construct t:j_m*O_Wm->j_n*O_Wn by pushing forward its canonical structure-sheaf map and using pushforwardComp. Substitute h>>j_m=j_n: its composite with j_m sharp equals j_n sharp by the definition of composition, and t on top sections is h.appTop. For the induced cokernel map q, cancel the epimorphism cokernel.π(i_m) to prove q>>E_n.hom=E_m.hom>>t. Indeed, cokernel.π_desc and both projection equations reduce this square to the structure-sheaf square. Evaluate it on top sections, use degree-zero naturality, and then the top-section formula for t to prove the second required equation. No surjectivity on global sections is used.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01IH, 01QP and 01DZ; existing principal-image, closed-immersion quotient and tensor-structure comparison APIs; cokernel cancellation formalized by U3

Second reader found closedImmersion_unit_quotient, and read its statement and proof. It identifies the ideal-product cokernel with pushforward of tensorPullback for fixed i and F, natural in F. It does not identify the multiplication-image cokernel with actual thickening sections or provide naturality as i varies. QuotientBaseChangeIdeal, PrincipalQuotientMultiplicationImage and upstream IdealSheaf.Module are complementary components. Closing the comparison still requires transport of the ideal images, pullback unit and H^0, not a direct application.

lean.statement:
theorem principal_thickening_cokernel_sections
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) :
    let p := fun n : ℕ ↦ Modules.smulHom (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
      ((((ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ W.ι.appTop) g) ^ (n + 1))
    let i := fun n : ℕ ↦ image.ι (p n)
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, Modules.H (cokernel (i n)) 0 ≃+
        Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n, ⊤),
      (∀ n (a : Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤)),
        e n (Modules.H.map (cokernel.π (i n)) 0
          ((Modules.H.zeroLinearEquiv _).symm a)) =
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n).appTop a) ∧
      (∀ (n m : ℕ) (κ : image (p m) ⟶ image (p n))
        (h : FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n ⟶
          FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W m)
        (hk : κ ≫ i n = i m),
        h ≫ FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W m =
          FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n →
        ∀ x, e n (Modules.H.map
          (cokernel.map (i m) (i n) κ (𝟙 _) (by simpa using hk.symm)) 0 x) =
          h.appTop (e m x))
